title: Business English Conversation 13:  A Free Trip
content: 1. frequent flier miles: points that one gets after purchasing and using an airline ticket if one is a member of the airline's program - I used my frequent flier miles and I got a free ticket. - She has over 100,000 frequent flier miles. 2. employees: people who work at a business - Our company has over 200 employees. - The employees are very happy at our company. 3. personal use: not using for business, only using in one's private life - We don't need to work 10 days a year. Those days are for personal use. - You can only use this credit card for business. You may not use it for personal use.
